title: Pão de Queijo com Bresaola
description: A Brazilian-inspired cheese bread accompanied by cured bresaola, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: 2. Slice the pão into 1-inch thick rounds.
3. Place the slices on a baking sheet, drizzle with melted butter, and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
4. Bake in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
5. Meanwhile, slice the bresaola into thin strips.
6. Remove the pão from the oven and let cool for a minute or two.
7. Split each pão round in half horizontally using a serrated knife.
8. Fill the pão with shredded cheese and top with a slice of bresaola.
